content.query: For each asset, compute its return from the close on the session before the first of the 20 trading sessions ending 2026-08-31 to the close on 2026-08-31. Then for each sector, give the number of assets and the median of those per-asset returns. Sort sectors by sector name.
content.answer: This query calculates each asset's 20‑day return up to 2026‑08‑31, then groups assets by sector to show how many assets are in each sector and the median return of those assets. It pulls the closing prices from the daily prices table, computes the return using the price from 20 days earlier, joins to the assets table for sector information, aggregates counts and medians per sector, and finally sorts the sectors alphabetically.
content.sql: WITH priced AS (SELECT p.asset_id, p.trading_date, p.close, LAG(p.close, 20) OVER (PARTITION BY p.asset_id ORDER BY p.trading_date ASC) AS close_20d_before FROM synthetic_market.main.daily_prices p WHERE p.trading_date <= DATE '2026-08-31'), returns AS (SELECT asset_id, (close - close_20d_before) / NULLIF(close_20d_before, 0) AS ret FROM priced WHERE trading_date = DATE '2026-08-31' AND close_20d_before IS NOT NULL) SELECT a.sector, COUNT(DISTINCT r.asset_id) AS asset_count, median(r.ret) AS median_return FROM returns r JOIN synthetic_market.main.assets a ON r.asset_id = a.asset_id GROUP BY a.sector ORDER BY a.sector;
